highlights.title: Matthew Rhys makes Emmy history as Widow’s Bay breaks records
highlights.summary: Matthew Rhys made Emmy history, winning two lead acting awards in the same night as Widow’s Bay swept the comedy categories and set a new record with 14 wins.
